correctness.rationale: The occupancy criterion is necessary and sufficient, and each deletion case is proved by matching lower and upper bounds. Exhaustive independent profile enumeration through order 11 and all bipartite profiles with shores at most 20 matches every formula. The computation is corroborative; the proof is arbitrary-order.

originality.rationale: The initiating stability paper treats complete and complete-bipartite graphs but not arbitrary complete multipartite graphs; its uniform biclique statement is not consistent with direct application of the invariant at K_{2,3} and K_{2,2}. Lu--Xu gives the baseline p-domination number but not stability. Searches found no statement implying the full deletion-stability classification.
